summary: Appends a 16-byte node carrying value a2 to a doubly-linked list owned by this. Allocates the node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16), initializes it (value at +0, next at +4, prev at +8, byte flag at +12), links it after the tail, updates the tail pointer, and increments the node count. On an empty list it also sets the head and a secondary pointer. No action is taken when a2 is NULL.

operations.description: Early return when a2 is NULL: if the value argument is zero, the function performs no action.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16): allocate 16 bytes for a new list node; the result pointer is held in v3.
Branch on the allocation result: if v3 is non-NULL the new node is initialized; otherwise v3 is forced to 0 and the dead NULL node is still linked below.
Initialize the new 16-byte node: *(DWORD*)v3 = a2 (value), *(v3+4) = 0 (next), *(v3+8) = 0 (prev), *(BYTE*)(v3+12) = 0 (byte flag).
Branch on the list head this[1591] (this+0x18DC): if non-NULL (list non-empty) link the new node after the tail; otherwise set both this[1591] (head) and this[1593] (secondary) to the new node.
On the non-empty path: set the old tail's next pointer *(this[1592]+4) to the new node and the new node's prev *(v3+8) to the old tail this[1592].
Update the tail pointer this[1592] (this+0x18E0) to the new node.
Increment the node count this[1594] (this+0x18E8) by 1.
void function; returns implicitly after the append.
